{"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. silver_transactions mixes the two, so v2 rows land 6 hours late (hence the 00:00-06:00 timestamps and some rows spilling into the next txn_date, such as 2026-01-19). Converting v2 rows to Chicago local time (UTC-6, all dates fall in CST) restores one consistent basis.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       adj_ts AS txn_ts,
       CAST(adj_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *,
         CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR
              ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS adj_ts
  FROM raw_transactions
) r
WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
